component-metadata.description:
This node parses the 'Amount' column of the input table and extracts the number and the unit. The extracted number or unit are given in the columns 'ExtractedNumber' and 'ExtractedUnit'. If the numberformat is not detectable or the reference unit is not detectable, the number and unit are extracted based on assumptions which are given in the additional column 'ExtractionComment'.
E.g. Amount: '100 Schalen x 0.5 kg Erdbeeren' --> ExtractedNumber: '50', ExtractedUnit: 'kg', ExtractionComment: '' Amount: '10,000 Stück' --> ExtractedNumber: '10000', ExtractedUnit: 'Stück', ExtractionComment:, 'Number was parsed with "." as decimal point assumption.'
